news.title: DOG Mode explains Bitcoin's next governance fight
news.summary: Leonidas' DOG Mode client challenges Bitcoin's default relay policies, reopening a philosophical debate over censorship, free markets and who really governs the network.

news.title: Crypto executives say digital native generations may never need a bank account
news.summary: Steakhouse Financial co-founder Adrian Cachinero says digital-native generations may rely less on banks, while Binance says younger users are already driving crypto adoption in emerging markets.

news.title: Bitcoin’s quantum problem gets a recovery tool, but not for Satoshi’s 1.1 million coins
news.summary: Project Eleven says it has funded a proof that lets a wallet's own key-derivation path stand in as ownership after quantum computers can forge its signatures. It runs in 243 milliseconds on a laptop.

news.title: Kraken says simpler options can unlock crypto's next derivatives market
news.summary: The Wyoming-based firm launched USD-settled bitcoin and ether options, saying product design, not demand, has held back adoption.

news.title: Tether's USDT hits 2-year countdown threatening its position on U.S. crypto platforms
news.summary: The GENIUS Act has hit its first anniversary without U.S. regulators yet meeting deadlines to write regulations, though rules will be in full effect by July 2028.

news.title: Bitcoin's biggest advocate, Michael Saylor, says new plan to clean up the blockchain is 'a bad idea'
news.summary: Michael Saylor argues that a new proposal, BIP-110, to temporarily block "spam" data from the Bitcoin blockchain would undermine the network's neutrality and create a dangerous precedent for censorshi
